from: chapitres 0, 6 et 7 de la vidéo longue (le latte à 13 cents de café, puis le ticket complet de la commande de 9 $ ; coupé : prix du café, détail des magasins, siège)
paragraphs: In a grande latte, the coffee itself costs about {thirteen cents|13¢}. So where does a {nine dollar|$9} Starbucks order go?
Starbucks' own numbers for {twenty twenty-six|2026} say about {four dollars|$4.08} goes to running the coffeehouse. The people, and the rent.
About {three dollars|$2.91} goes to food, cups, coffee and the trucks that carry it all.
A little over {a dollar|$1.14} for the head office and equipment. About {twenty seven cents|27¢} for interest and taxes.
And about {sixty cents|60¢} is profit. You're not really paying for coffee. You're renting the room. Full story on the channel.
